summary: Tested Minecraft Fractions backend (FastAPI + Emergent LLM Claude Sonnet 4.5) and frontend (React tabbed SPA). 7/7 backend pytest cases pass including health, root and POST /api/problems/generate across all topic/difficulty combos with full schema/range validation. Frontend smoke + integration flows pass: navigation, BlockLab sliders/presets/block-type, Practice answer + Next, AI Quest end-to-end (LLM call returns valid problem with 4 choices, feedback + explanation, Another Quest button), Achievements page (first_block + redstone_engineer auto-unlocked on AI correct answer), localStorage persists across reload, Reset World clears progress. No console/page errors.

issues: Sonner toast (top-center) visually overlaps nav tabs AI QUEST / INVENTORY for ~4s, partially blocking real-user clicks; consider top-right placement or shorter duration
Locked-achievement icon block and title use very low contrast (gray on gray) making the text hard to read; consider lightening the locked label color

action_items: Consider moving toast position from top-center (it overlaps the right-side nav tabs after answer feedback) or reduce auto-dismiss duration
Improve contrast of locked achievement labels for accessibility
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: `logger` is referenced inside generate_problem (logger.exception) but defined at module-bottom after route registration. It works at request-time but is fragile; move logging.basicConfig + logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) above the routes.
backend/server.py: No persistence/caching of generated problems to MongoDB even though Mongo client is connected; either remove the unused Mongo wiring or persist generated problems for analytics.
backend/server.py: LLM error returns 500 with raw exception string -- could leak internal details; return generic message and log details.
frontend/AIQuestPage.jsx: When LLM call fails, the previous problem stays visible with no retry hint other than a toast; consider an empty-state error card.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in app (localStorage only)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py and exercise /api/health, /api/, and /api/problems/generate with parametrized topics/difficulties. LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations) takes 2-6s per call; allow >30s timeouts. Frontend uses Sonner toast at top-center which can occlude top nav clicks -- in Playwright use force=True or wait 4-5s before subsequent nav clicks. All testIds from spec are present and working: nav-{home|visualize|practice|ai|achievements}, cta-{play|visualize|ai}, op-*, diff-*, choice-0..3, next-problem, generate-quest, ai-choice-0..3, ai-next, ai-topic-*, ai-diff-*, reset-progress, achievement-{id}, numerator-slider, denominator-slider, block-{kind}, preset-{n}-{d}.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. The Practice question screenshot showing '2/2 + 1/4' with choices including '1' is mathematically valid (2/2 + 1/4 = 5/4, but 2/2=1 so 1 + 1/4 = 5/4 -- '5/4' is among the choices and is the correct answer). Local generator in fractions.js appears to work correctly.
